entries.basis: Every shipped owned drag-operation family is mapped to keyboard and single-pointer alternatives. New calendar controls share the drag solver/constraints without another popup; editor two-click rectangles preserve actual focus/Escape and nested-editor ownership; optional shelf width steps share measured bounds. Six unchanged calendar/shelf native passes plus three corrected editor passes across three engines, 28 unique focused unit tests and current catalog/type checks support integration commit 4e5d9fd9.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-X-08 Reconcile original `X-08`: Provide both keyboard and single-pointer non-drag alternatives for drag operations where required; keyboard support alone does not satisfy every dragging requirement. Historical status: open.

limits: Native text/image drag and arbitrary host-added plugins are outside owned drag operations. Reused grid/page/sort evidence is identified as retained, not rerun. No spoken-AT, physical-device or complete accessibility conformance claim; D15/X06/X07/X11 remain separate.
